title: A finite family of boundary ideals detects the resolution property
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must replace the requirement to resolve every finite-type quasi-coherent sheaf by finitely many specified ideal quotients. It descends the boundary ideals and vector bundles to a Noetherian model, then extends generators across boundary ideal powers and uses tensor powers of the chosen bundles to resolve an arbitrary coherent sheaf.
